Core Strengths and Coursework

Strongest areas, in order: 1. Mathematics    2. Coding & Computer Science.

Mathematics: Real Analysis, Abstract Algebra, Topology, Linear Algebra, Differential Equations and Applications, Functional Analysis, Complex Analysis, Differential Geometry, Differentiable Manifolds, Wavelet Analysis, and Numerical Analysis. Coursework includes measure and integration, convergence, groups and rings, vector spaces, eigenvalues, boundary-value problems, Fourier methods, and numerical approximation.
Numerical & Mathematical Reasoning: Root-finding, interpolation, numerical integration, Runge-Kutta methods, finite differences, stability analysis, approximation, and error estimation. Relevant foundation for checking multi-step solutions, assumptions, and numerical accuracy.
Coding: C programming fundamentals including control flow, arrays, strings, pointers, functions, recursion, structures, and file handling. Java coursework includes object-oriented programming, classes, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, collections, and exception handling.
Computer Science: Data structures and algorithms in C/Java: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, searching, sorting, BFS/DFS, and time/space complexity. Operating Systems: processes, scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, memory management, and file systems. DBMS: relational models, ER diagrams, normalization, transactions, and SQL.
Physics: Undergraduate study in mechanics, motion, waves, optics, electricity and magnetism, measurement, and mathematical modelling of physical systems. Supports quantitative and scientific reasoning.
Chemistry: Undergraduate study in physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry, with scientific observation, quantitative reasoning, and laboratory-based concepts.
Communication: Hindi (native) and professional English for reading, writing, explanation, and structured technical communication.
